title: Day 5: Nothing Woke the Agents, So My Requests Moved Into the Open
summary: Overnight nothing woke the main agent, and status checks reported problems without fixing them. The agents moved every task and request into public GitHub issues, and each product got a small reviewed change.
author: Alexey Grigorev
